task.title: End of training allowed — MPS claim

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the referred training end date shown on the Project tab is correct:
Determine which authority referred the client to the training:

ul.li: If a provincial or territorial designated authority referred the client, go to step 3.
If Service Canada referred the client, go to step 7.
If a designated authority referred the client to apprenticeship training , go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine if the referred training ended earlier than initially declared:

ul.li: If yes, accept the client’s statement and go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine if there is documentation on file from the referring authority confirming the referred training end date:

ul.li: If no, fact-find with the client and inform the client that the referring authority must provide the documentation. Go to step 5. fact-find

step.cmd: In NWS, move the referred training WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “EIA 25 — end date documentation is required.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if the required documentation from the referring authority is on file:
In FTS, determine if there is a revised registration number for the referred training issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “EIA 25 — Change to the training end date is required.”
Remarks line 3: If necessary, enter the claimant’s report information.
Remarks line 4: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Details: Type “Meets levels of decision criteria to allow at Level 1.”
